name: mistral
description: Mistral's user-initiated fetcher, MistralAI-User, which visits a page when a user's question needs it and is not an automatic crawler. Classifies as agent/mistral from the User-Agent alone, at medium confidence. The User-Agent is transcribed verbatim from Mistral's published crawler documentation (https://docs.mistral.ai/robots, fetched 2026-09-28); it is not captured from our own traffic, and the other headers are illustrative.

headers.user-agent: Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko; compatible; MistralAI-User/1.0; +https://docs.mistral.ai/robots)
